query:
UPDATE deliveries
                SET status = $3,
                    next_attempt_at = COALESCE($4, next_attempt_at),
                    last_error = COALESCE($5, last_error),
                    finished_at = CASE WHEN $3 = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE now() END,
                    claim_token = NULL,
                    leased_until = NULL
                WHERE id = $1 AND claim_token = $2
